assets.name: announcing-angel-with-clouds-and-curled-blank-scroll
assets.description: An announcing angel on blue clouds holding a curled pale scroll. Part of the Shepherds Annunciation floral ornaments set.

provenance.title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Annunciation to the Shepherds (recto)

extraction.prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Extract ONLY the announcing angel, its red/cream robes, white feathered wing, pale halo, surrounding irregular painted cloud bodies and curled BLANK pale scroll. Remove the ENTIRE smooth dark-blue starry sky and ALL the gold/black arch framing the miniature. No detached gold stars, no smooth blue sky wedge, no outer arch. The blue-and-white lobed clouds are part of the selected subject and stay opaque; distinguish them from the flat starry blue background. Preserve original exact cloud contours and faint painting. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.

native_subject_size_evidence.method: Individually inspected native visible subject bounds, excluding input-region whitespace and neighbours.

extraction.subject_resolution_cap_method: Both subject axes capped to inspected native subject bounds; input-region whitespace cannot permit subject upscaling.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

review.notes: Each complete original ROI, white and dark proof inspected. Coronation retains Christ, Mary, six angels and their actual shared throne, clears the floor/gold field and real architectural openings; two foreground kneelers also already available separately. Angel retains all original wing, white scroll and blue/white clouds while starry sky/arch cleared. Both small leaf terminals retain their actual pale/colored folds and original silhouettes without invented branches.

assets.usage_notes: Original independent specimen with printed plate rules and page removed. AI-assisted extraction remains approximate; source bounds, actual native subject cap, original and exact prompt retained.
